nodes.note: The chapel's nave: the party arrives in its aisle, the vestry chest with the roll stands by the altar, and the lantern waits in a barrel under the loft stair.

stations.note: The vestry chest beside the altar, where the muster roll is kept.
A barrel against the nave wall at the foot of the loft stair, holding the watch lantern.

nodes.note: The loft at the south end of the nave, up the stair: the reading lectern against the glazed screen in its front, and an iron chain hanging from the ceiling beside it.

stations.note: The lectern against the glazed screen at the front of the loft, the reader facing the nave through the glass.
The end of the chain hanging from the loft ceiling beside the lectern, where a lantern hangs.
